(assertContained)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="2450" y="195" width="150" height="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="notes" value="CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE NOTES

✔ Single chokepoint — ALL outward effects funnel through ActionGate → ExecutorRegistry. Agents/packs cannot bypass (ceiling refuses unknown action types pre-gate).
✔ Earned autonomy — trust ledger gates per action-type; graduation needs explicit approval; reject/undo = instant demote; hard ceilings can't be flipped.
✔ Privacy walls — personal_* (bank) + inbound email content NEVER indexed into recall; money pack is private-chat only; dream/speculate exclude money+email by construction.
✔ Resilience — heartbeat fire-and-forget + try/caught clock loop; per-account watcher backoff; fail-silent dream/speculate; claim-before-execute + startup stale-recovery.

⚠ Cross-cutting coupling — EventBus + Store touched by nearly every module (god-object risk; edges omitted, shown as rails →).
⚠ 60s SDK limit — long work must NOT run in MCP tool handlers → JobManager enqueues; engine notifies moderator on completion.
⚠ Concurrency-1 queue — serial overnight research; no token/cost-budget enforcement yet (K-job cap only).
⚠ Uncommitted pdf-attachments WIP in the working tree (out of this diagram's scope)." div.div:
CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE NOTES
✔ Single chokepoint — ALL outward effects funnel through ActionGate → ExecutorRegistry. Agents/packs cannot bypass (ceiling refuses unknown action types pre-gate).
✔ Earned autonomy — trust ledger gates per action-type; graduation needs explicit approval; reject/undo = instant demote; hard ceilings can't be flipped.
✔ Privacy walls — personal_* (bank) + inbound email content NEVER indexed into recall; money pack is private-chat only; dream/speculate exclude money+email by construction.
✔ Resilience — heartbeat fire-and-forget + try/caught clock loop; per-account watcher backoff; fail-silent dream/speculate; claim-before-execute + startup stale-recovery.
⚠ Cross-cutting coupling — EventBus + Store touched by nearly every module (god-object risk; edges omitted, shown as rails →).
⚠ 60s SDK limit — long work must NOT run in MCP tool handlers → JobManager enqueues; engine notifies moderator on completion.
⚠ Concurrency-1 queue — serial overnight research; no token/cost-budget enforcement yet (K-job cap only).
